title: Mukdahan Desserts 2026 — 10 Cake, Bakery & Gelato Spots | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The best dessert, bakery, cake and gelato cafes open right now in Mukdahan, Thailand — with neighborhoods, opening hours and rough prices, picked from places locals actually go.
keywords: Mukdahan desserts, Mukdahan bakery, Mukdahan cake shops, Mukdahan gelato, Mukdahan dessert cafe
intro: Mukdahan is a small town on the Mekong, and its dessert scene is more fun than you'd expect. There are old-school cake shops that locals have bought from for generations, fresh homemade bakeries, and a newer crowd making their own gelato and pastries. We've picked 10 spots that are genuinely open right now, split into cake-and-bakery and ice-cream-and-cold-treats, with the neighborhood, opening hours and rough prices so they're easy to drop into.

blocks.html: Mukdahan isn't big — you can drive from one side of town to the other in a few minutes, so you can hit several dessert spots in a single day. The shops here split roughly into two groups. The first is cakes and bakeries you can buy on the spot or order for a birthday — many are long-running places locals are attached to. The second is cold-dessert spots like gelato and bingsu, plus cafes that are better known for their sweets than their coffee. We've ranked them by how worth a stop they are and how consistent the flavors stay, rather than crowning a single best shop, because each one stands out in a different way.

blocks.text: Cake and bakery shops, for now or to order ahead

blocks.html: Mukdahan's cake-and-bakery side runs from long-established shops the whole town knows to homemade spots baking fresh day by day. Most sit in the town center and are easy to reach. If you want a whole cake for a birthday or event, call to reserve at least a day ahead — these are small shops baking fresh, and they sell out fast.

items.name: Srisombat Bakery
items.blurb: An old-school cake shop that Mukdahan locals have bought from for generations, over by Danang Market on Phithak Phanomkhet Road. Known for its fresh-butter cakes and wallet-friendly birthday cakes, with the familiar taste of traditional Thai bakery. You can order whole cakes — call ahead to reserve.
items.meta: Danang Market, Phithak Phanomkhet Rd · Tel 098 296 3665
items.price: Slices from ฿25–45 · whole cakes by size

items.name: Balance Cafe
items.blurb: A bakery cafe on Sribunrueang Road, open morning to evening every day. The most-ordered item is the banana muffin — baked fresh and buttery, and it pairs nicely with coffee. There's a rotating selection of baked goods, so it's a good morning stop before you start exploring, or to grab something to go.

items.name: Hana's Cake
items.blurb: A homemade cake shop in Pailin Village, Soi Klin Prathumthip, baking cakes and pastries fresh day to day with careful detail. It's a good pick if you like prettily decorated cakes for a special occasion. It works more as an order-ahead shop than a retail storefront, so message to reserve first.
items.meta: Pailin Village, Soi Klin Prathumthip · order ahead
items.price: Whole cakes by design and size

items.name: Yaimai and Mamii Homemade Bakery
items.blurb: A homemade bakery run by the family, focused on fresh baked goods like cookies, brownies and cake slices — not too sweet, made with good ingredients. It's a small place locals keep coming back to, good for a snack or to take home. Check their page for baking days before you go.
items.meta: In Mukdahan town · order via their page

items.name: Kaikai Thailand (Egg Cake), Mukdahan Branch
items.blurb: A Taiwanese-style egg cake shop with soft, fluffy texture, on Phithak Phanomkhet Road next to the Esso station. The draw is the egg cakes baked fresh and warm, buttery and easy to keep eating, and easy on the wallet. Good to grab a box to snack on along the way or hand to friends.
items.meta: 44/4 Phithak Phanomkhet Rd, next to Esso station

blocks.title: Tip for ordering a whole cake
blocks.html: Most cake shops in Mukdahan are small and bake fresh. If you want a whole birthday cake or a special custom design, call or message the shop's page to reserve at least a day ahead — the storefronts usually keep only a limited number of cake slices ready, and once they're gone, they're gone.

blocks.text: Ice cream, gelato and cold treats to beat the heat

blocks.html: Mukdahan is sunny almost year-round, so cold desserts sell well. This group rounds up house-churned gelato, bingsu and cold treats you can sit and enjoy in the shop. It's a good afternoon stop after walking around in the sun, or to cap off dinner with a cool bowl of something sweet.

items.name: i bakery and gelato
items.blurb: A bakery that also makes its own gelato, sitting in front of Krungthai Bank in the town center, so it's easy to find. The highlight is the dense, many-flavored gelato — both fruit and milk based — which you can pair with the in-house pastries. Good for an afternoon cool-down, with comfortable air-conditioned seating.
items.meta: In front of Krungthai Bank, town center

items.name: goodmook* cafe
items.blurb: A long-running cafe given a fresh renovation in the old town on Song Nang Sathit Road, near the Mekong. Beyond coffee, it's strong on bakery and desserts, with vintage-retro decor and plenty of seating. Friday and Saturday it stays open until 10pm, so you can keep eating after sunset.
items.meta: Song Nang Sathit Rd, old town · Tue–Sun 9:00–22:00 (closed Mon)

items.name: Scrubs Cafe
items.blurb: A minimalist, spacious cafe in town with board games to play, strong on pastries and several grades of matcha drinks. It's a good spot to settle in for a long stretch, ordering snacks with friends in an easy atmosphere. Closed Wednesdays.

items.name: HUNGRY BEAR coffee society
items.blurb: A small cafe tucked into a garden on Mueang Mai Road, shady and quiet. It has bakery and desserts to order alongside your drink, at friendly prices, and the most-ordered item is the soda-based drinks. Good for anyone who likes a quiet corner to relax with something sweet.

items.name: Mister Donut, Big C Mukdahan
items.blurb: If you want a standard brand dessert with familiar flavors, Mister Donut's donuts and cold drinks inside Big C are an easy choice. Good to grab while wandering the mall out of the sun, or to buy a box to keep eating on the road.
items.meta: Big C Mukdahan · open with mall hours

blocks.title: Straight talk
blocks.html: Most dessert shops in Mukdahan are small to mid-sized, and some are order-ahead spots without a clear retail storefront. Before you go, check their page or call to ask whether they have anything for sale that day — especially the homemade ones, since they don't bake every day. The gelato shops and dessert cafes are a surer bet for a storefront where you can sit and eat.

blocks.text: Pick a shop by the occasion

blocks.html: Choosing a Mukdahan dessert isn't hard once you know what you're after. Here's a quick breakdown to help you decide fast.

items: To take home as a gift — Kaikai Thailand egg cake is easy to grab by the box, or cookies and brownies from Yaimai and Mamii, freshly made and not too sweet.
To order a birthday or event cake — Srisombat Bakery is wallet-friendly and traditional, while Hana's Cake focuses on pretty, detailed decoration. Reserve both ahead.
To cool off in the afternoon — dense gelato at i bakery and gelato in the town center, with cool air-conditioned seating.
To linger over dessert — goodmook in the old town stays open late Friday and Saturday, or Scrubs with board games to play.
For an early-morning stop before sightseeing — warm banana muffins at Balance Cafe, open from 7am every day.

blocks.html: If you have two days in Mukdahan and want to cover several dessert styles without rushing, you can pace it like this. Start gently — day one leans on bakeries and gelato in town, while day two picks up the old-school shops and the linger-a-while spots in the old town.

faq.q: Which Mukdahan cake shop is the old-school local favorite?
faq.a: Srisombat Bakery near Danang Market is the long-running shop that Mukdahan locals have bought from for generations, known for fresh-butter cakes and wallet-friendly birthday cakes. If you want a prettily decorated, detailed cake for a special occasion, Hana's Cake is a homemade shop you can order ahead from. Call or message to reserve at both.

faq.q: Does Mukdahan have a gelato or house-churned ice cream shop?
faq.a: Yes — i bakery and gelato, in front of Krungthai Bank in the town center, makes its own gelato in several flavors, both fruit and milk based, with a dense texture. You can sit and eat in the cool air-conditioned shop, which makes it a good afternoon cool-down.

faq.q: What's a good Mukdahan dessert to buy as a gift?
faq.a: Kaikai Thailand egg cake (Mukdahan branch) is easy to buy by the box — soft, freshly baked and easy on the wallet. If you'd rather have homemade baked goods, the cookies and brownies from Yaimai and Mamii are freshly made and not too sweet, good to take home. Check their page for baking days before you go.

faq.q: Roughly how much do desserts cost in Mukdahan?
faq.a: Most cake slices and bakery items run around ฿25–80, gelato scoops ฿45–80, and whole cakes are priced by size and design. It's noticeably cheaper than shops in big cities. Drinks at the dessert cafes generally run ฿45–80 a glass.

faq.q: Which Mukdahan dessert spot is good for lingering?
faq.a: Scrubs is a spacious minimalist cafe with board games to play, good for settling in with friends. And goodmook in the old town near the Mekong is open until 10pm Friday and Saturday, so you can keep eating dessert after sunset. Both have plenty of seating and an easy atmosphere.
